ITEM 1 | Roasted or fried potato-like chunks, about 5 pieces, golden-brown to tan with darker caramelized edges and patches, irregular wedge/cube shapes roughly 3-4 cm long and 2 cm thick, slightly glossy with light oil sheen, firm cut surfaces, small cluster piled in the center-left of a white square plate about 26 cm across | 150

ITEM 2 | Light brown oily glaze or seasoning residue, faint sheen on the plate surface around and beneath the chunks, no distinct pooling, very thin film | 3
